A UI frame of the panel of the cartoon UI style for a bright casual puzzle and party game of saga maps, bundles and round results: a panel's border and ground, its centre plain so text reads on it.
Style: Storybook ornament. Gentle contours, patterned plants and soft colour shapes make explorable picture-book worlds. Flat illustrated planes, ornamental plants and patterns, gentle coloured lines, overlapping layers for space.
Palette: at most 32 distinct colours in this asset; 16 to 32 colours; soft saturated hues, coloured line work, patterns from the same palette.
Nine-slice: the corners (25% left, 25% top, 25% right, 25% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Conform: the cook then the look's 2-pixel outline drawn round the shape (docs/art.md §2.3): draw for that.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: a dark brown #2a1a10 line about 2 pixels wide at the size it is seen.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: black outlines; realistic lighting; empty unpatterned fills; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single panel only, centred, filling the image across its width, 1.00 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 96 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A cartoon panel: a fully opaque warm cream (#fff4dc) slab with softly rounded corners (about 18 px at this size), a thick 4 px dark chocolate-brown (#3a2210) cartoon outline all round, a lighter inner rim just inside the outline and a chunky darker shadow lip along its bottom edge, the centre flat cream so dark text reads on it; as the cream board of the concept's settings, without its title ribbon. Plain corners: no leaves, flowers, vines or corner ornaments anywhere; the thick outline and the rim are its only decoration. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
